description: Turn a secret (a password, API key, recovery code or private note) into a link a person opens once. The secret is encrypted on this machine before anything is sent, and X-TKN never holds the key. The link stops working once opened, or at its expiry. You cannot read the secret back afterwards: this server has no read tool. Returns the link and a code for check_status and revoke_secret. Up to 64 KB on the free Developer plan, 256 KB on Team and Enterprise.

expiresIn.description: How long the link works if nobody opens it. Defaults to the plan's: 7 days on Developer, 30 on Team.

note.description: A note for your own records, shown in the X-TKN console and never to the recipient. Stored unencrypted, so never put the secret in it.

passphrase.description: Make the recipient type this before the secret opens. Send it by a different channel than the link. X-TKN stores a hash of it, which gates the link and plays no part in the encryption. Team plan and above.

recipientEmail.description: Make the recipient enter a 6-digit code emailed to this address before the secret opens. Team plan and above. Set this or passphrase, not both.

secret.description: The secret to hand over. It is encrypted before it leaves this machine.

name: create_secret

code.description: Pass this to check_status or revoke_secret.

link.description: The one-time link for the recipient.

title: Create a one-time secret link
